images/000000478717.jpg: I like the incongruity of this little red and green visitor leaning over a thick book. The dark chairs, table edge and tree trunks almost compete with those bright feathers.
images/000000137788.jpg: The pantry looks packed until my eye drops to the bottom shelf. There's a fluffy dog curled up there as though someone put it away with the groceries; it makes me smile.
images/000000020371.jpg: I like how the diagonal gutter gives this very still pigeon a stage to itself. Its square-on stare stands out against a soft, empty wash of green.
images/000000231022.jpg: The slash of sunlight across one eye is beautiful. There's something quite severe about this pale cat holding still against the dark upholstery, all shadows and very little color.
images/000000068293.jpg: The red throat against that brilliant green head is what draws me in. It's a lovely little bird, sitting so still that the long beak almost looks like another twig.
images/000000196355.jpg: Black and white makes the contrast between the two horses especially clear. Both riders sit upright on stationary mounts; the whole scene has the formality of a posed portrait.
images/000000480205.jpg: I like the elegant bend in the heron's neck. Its level bill and watchful posture look intent rather than playful; pointed blades of grass jostle around that clean outline.
images/000000066652.jpg: The giraffe looks faintly comical sitting so low in the grass with that long neck sticking straight up. I like the contrast between its folded body and its upright, attentive face.
images/000000516328.jpg: The crane and the hydrant make an odd couple. The bright blue cap and yellow post almost steal the picture from the gray bird, whose long bill points right out across the grass.
images/000000177529.jpg: I love the tiny gap between those noses. The kitten leans toward a muzzle nearly as big as its body; despite the size difference the meeting feels gentle and endearing.
images/000000557329.jpg: The round bird sits quietly but I don't particularly like the picture. Leaves and stems cut across one another, and the bright soft-edged patch on its breast makes the subject harder to pick out.
images/000000132760.jpg: The handler and pony are heading away across the ring. It looks like serious business, but my eye wanders to the swarm of spectators, rails and tent poles behind them.
images/000000221542.jpg: I like this rather intimidating close view: the jutting beak and enormous feet have more presence than prettiness. The dusty ground and corrugated wall keep the colors subdued.
images/000000493438.jpg: There's a tenderness to the little striped foal resting in the shade beside the standing zebra. I find the pairing beautiful; even with all those twigs overhead, the two bodies look quite at ease.
images/000000438107.jpg: That orange bill looms very large, while the second swan bends its neck the other way. The echo of the two heads is amusing, though there is a lot happening behind the nearer face.
images/000000022894.jpg: The floppy ears and white blaze make this puppy especially endearing to me. It's lying quietly in the grass, looking straight up over the pale rim in the foreground.
